notes.title: 白湖游戏购满30即送精品独立游戏
notes.content:
[h1]秋季促销期间（北京时间11.27-12.4），购买白湖系列游戏满30元即可获赠一份自选精品独立游戏。[/h1]

*精品游戏分别限量领取10份，先到先得。

[h1]活动规则[/h1]
[list]
[*] 加入Q群：[b]780180651[/b]，把购买凭证截图后私信发给群主：@发奖Bot，即可领取精品游戏；
[*] 消费需全部发生在秋促期间；
[*] 奖品数量有限，每人限领一次。
[/list]

notes.title: NEW THING: REMAKE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676558/6313aa620b279cf8610b9b8f33816406d7bdbc62.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone, we are bringing you a huge update for WenJia[/h1]

[code]
[list]
[*] Huge amount of interactive elements.
[*] New storyline and new music were added
[*] We adjusted the game's difficulty, it will be a little bit more challenge, but you can still download the Easy Mode Pack for free
[*] Game animation adjustment
[*] Game resource optimization
[*] To help players get familiar with WenJia's world,we put in a  clearer tutorial than before
[*] Process optimization when interacting with animals
[/list][/code]

Please enjoy the new version of WenJia. Also, we want to say thank you to all those players who help us in improving the game. 8D
